The causal chain in the claim (reform → facilitated privatization → destroyed legacy) goes beyond what the excerpt supports. The excerpt supports that López Obrador used the reform to argue for privatization concerns, but the claim treats the privatization effect as an established fact. Furthermore, the PRI counter-argument about maintaining state property is mentioned in the following sentence of the source, not in the cited excerpt. A composite claim assembled from two non-contiguous sentences violates the verbatim-excerpt rule.
